headline: How Realty Income’s (O) New Monthly Dividend and High Payout Debate Has Changed Its Investment Story
summary: Realty Income recently declared a total monthly dividend of US$0.27 per share with an ex-dividend date that passed on 31 July 2026, while attention also builds around its upcoming 5 August 2026 earnings release. The announcement has renewed focus on the REIT’s long record of monthly dividends and raised questions about the sustainability of its high payout ratio. We will now examine how this fresh dividend declaration, and the debate around its sustainability, influences Realty Income’s...
